WHO IS TOM BRENCHLEY, Why Should I Listen To Him?
I was skinny
Then I overcame that
Then I became overweight
Then I overcame that
Hi, my name is Tom...
Hi, my name is Tom...

I am a dad of 5, yep 5 kids...


You might think that's tough going...


Well 3 of them have autism and 1 has epilepsy, so it's safe to say things get pretty full on around here!


Due to poor time management, grabbing "convenient food" and feeling too exhausted to leave the house after a hard days work...


I've struggled with my weight for years.


And as my weight went up, my energy levels went down.


I was so tired all the time.


I felt guilty, as I wasn't giving my kids enough of my time.

They wanted to play and do fun things but I was always felt drained..


Within 5 minutes of kicking a ball around or playing chase, I would be out of breath and needing to sit down.


The kids wouldn't say they were disappointed...


But you could always see it in their eyes.

It was heart wrenching.


This led to me feeling like I looked like a sack of sh*t, I had back fat (love handles, that I did not love) and moobs, I mean I felt a mess.

This also affected my libido, I just wasn't feeling like the man I was and the man I knew I should be...


I knew I wasn't attractive, I was ashamed by how I looked, mortified and embarrassed...


So why would I expect my partner to want to rip my clothes off and want to have sex with me.


My poor partner she must've felt like a born again virgin (I can proudly report that we are firing on all cylinders again now haha).


Side Note - Did you know obesity and low testosterone levels can lead to erectile dysfunction.


I knew I needed to do something...


Being a fitness professional I knew my metabolism was on the decline with age and I had to figure out a way that was going to turn me into a fat burning machine 24/7, that was also be time efficient.


I didn't want to spend countless hours in the gym, because, lets face it, as you get older and have more responsibilities, you have less time for yourself.


This led to the creation of my METABOLIC MATRIX FAT LOSS SYSTEM.


I have helped hundreds of Dad's get into the best shape of their lives.


My clients have included celebrities, busy professionals, and everyday individuals, like myself, who just want to feel better about themselves.

  

I have been in the fitness industry 15 years and know many tricks to break through those annoying weight loss plateaus, which means you're getting access to someone who can finally help you lose the gut and finally feel like the strong, confident Dad you want to be.

 

You might be thinking... what makes this program different than the countless others out there? 


The answer is simple..... 


Most coaches don't know what it’s like to lose over 45 pounds or what it's like to be skinny and build muscle before Google or using YouTube to get the answer. I’ve lived both experiences.


That's why you are going to be my next successful client.
There Is No Man On The Planet Who Wants To Have Man Boobs Is There?

text.value: Let's Talk About You.... Here are....
5 PROBLEMS MAKING IT FEEL IMPOSSIBLE TO LOSE WEIGHT
AND WE MUST ADDRESS THEM RIGHT NOW...
HERE'S THE DEAL...
I've outlined below, the REAL reasons you can't lose weight...

The Real Reason You Can't Lose Fat, Maximize Body Definition and Boost Your Metabolism is Because You've Only Been Taught to Exploit One (Or, If You're Lucky, Two) of the 3 Pillars Of A Fitness Transformation That Are Responsible for Dropping The Fat, Ditching The Man Boobs and Destroying The Love Handles!
PROBLEM #1 - YOYO DIETS!
THE DIETS YOU HAVE TRIED AREN'T SUSTAINABLE. YOU WOULDN'T EAT THEM FOR THE REST OF YOUR LIFE, EVERYDAY & BE SATISFIED WITH THEM...

I think by now, we all understand that nutrition is truly the main key to success for having a major fitness 

transformation AND maintain your hard earned results.


I get it: you get bored of eating the same foods over and over,


you’re a late night snacker, maybe you’re a stress eater or maybe you’re someone who

doesn’t eat all day due to being busy and when the day flies by, you end up binging...

on the foods you told yourself you weren’t going to eat. 


Fast food, chips, beige coloured food, microwave dinners, sweets, etc. 


You’ve tried over...and over...and over again.


This diet, that diet, and you seem to always have a bit of success,

You lose some weight but after a little while, you want to jump off a bridge because you can’t take it anymore,

and pack those pounds right back on… (maybe even a few extra)
PROBLEM #2 - EATING "HEALTHY"
LACK OF NUTRITION, CALORIC & NOURISHMENT KNOWLEDGE & GUIDANCE TO START ON THE RIGHT TRACK...

Short and sweet. You are willing to put in the work but you just don’t know where to start. 


What do I eat? How much? Are carbs bad? Should I do Keto? What’s Intermittent Fasting? Should I join a gym? Should I 

weight lift? What if I never lifted before?


 The list goes on and on...which brings me to my next point...
PROBLEM #3 - INFO OVERLOAD!

TOO MUCH CONFUSION, TOO MANY DIETS & INFORMATION OVERLOAD ON

WHAT WORKOUTS YOU SHOULD DO...

There’s SO MUCH information and products out there!


You’ve tried “everything.” You name it, you’ve tried it.


Weight Watchers, Slimming World, Whole 30, Keto… Atkins, P90X, Bootcamps,

7 Day Challenges… Creams, Waist Wraps, Fat Burners...


You’ve even hired a personal trainer before! (I thought that alone was supposed to be the cure.)

So here you are, year by year, in the same place.


Stuck and frustrated, asking yourself is it even worth trying anymore?


You ask yourself..."Maybe this is just how life was meant to be for me..."
PROBLEM #4 - SLO-GO CARDIO!

THE CARDIO PROBLEM. THEY'VE TAUGHT YOU CARDIO ALONE WITH 

SOME AT-HOME WORKOUTS WILL DO THE TRICK...

I’ll cut right to the chase and I’ll probably get some backlash for it but it’s the truth. 


Listen, there is only so much you can at home with 2 pound dumbbells, some bands and your bodyweight. Sure, you'll lose a couple of pounds, but then you'll hit a major plateau and it's hard to get out of it. 


Or maybe you go to the gym 4 times a week, but just don't know what you're doing really. You try this machine, 

then that machine and then some cardio. You see what others are doing and think it's going to work for you, but it doesn't. 


Most of those exercises don't work anyway, but there you are copying what the

guy next to you is doing. It's the blind leading the blind.

text.value: PROBLEM #5 - QUITTING!
WHO'S GOING TO STOP YOU FROM QUITTING? NOBODY'S THERE TO HOLD YOU ACCOUNTABLE...

You start off hot for a couple of days but then someone brings in brownies and cookies to work, it's Maccie D's Monday, your co-workers want to go out for Happy Hour, the weekend comes and it's a free for all.


You tell yourself you'll keep I under control but that never works out. It's this person's birthday and that person's wedding.


There's ALWAYS something that throws you off track, every...single...time you decide to start over. So what happens? You know what happens.


You tell yourself a lie and say "I'll just start again on Monday." You can't keep yourself accountable.

Someone will have to...

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
How soon will I start seeing results?
I've designed the program to get you sustained, lasting results as quickly as possible. While everybody is different - you can expect to see results within the two weeks!
Do you have any type of guarantee?
Yes if you do the workouts at least 3 times per week and don't see the results in the first 30 days, you will get your money back.
How exactly do you help?

I will personally coach you, one on one. No "coaches" or cookie cutter programs. I will design a scientific program based on your needs and schedule. I will design a schedule to optimise your time and effort. I will provide weekly check in's and adjustments to your program. You'll be able to track everything through my training app and will be able to reach me every day.
Will I get the support I need when my body stops changing?
Yes, you will have complete access to me. I'm here to make sure that if you do hit a plateau, we find a solution to work out of it right away.

text.value: Will I get a step-by-step roadmap even if I’m just getting back into shape?

Yes, I will provide a step by step plan so we are both on the same page. You will get weekly updates on adjustments as well. This is not just a workout program - it's a partnership, and we both need to be on the same path.

text.value: Can I pay you after I get the results?

You're not paying for a training program. While my stuff WILL change your life, you're actually paying for speed of results, accountability and zero guesswork with your workouts. When you fall off track or plateau I'm here to fix that. The only clients that get results are the ones that invest into themselves and don't want a free handout. So as the old saying goes "If there's no skin in the game, there's no game"
